name: request-access
title: Request access
description: Routes a recipient without a code to the preview owner. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

meta.whenToUse: Recipients arrive without a working code — a forwarded invitation, a link that sat too long — and need a route back to the owner.
meta.notFor: Sending the request. Nothing leaves the browser: you supply a link or a callback and deliver the message yourself.
pitfalls: With neither `requestAccessHref` nor `onRequestAccess` set, the component renders its unavailable label rather than a dead control. Supply one of them.
meta.contract: Routes a recipient without a code to the preview owner. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

props.name: requestAccessHref
props.description: Destination URL or mailto address. Takes precedence over callback. Only relative, http(s), and mailto URLs are supported.

props.name: onRequestAccess
props.description: Called when requesting access without a destination URL.

props.name: labels
props.type: { description?: string; action?: string; unavailable?: string; }

properties.name: unavailable
properties.default: 'Contact the preview owner for a code.'

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows the system preference.

defaults.labels.unavailable: 'Contact the preview owner for a code.'

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; lifecycle messages use polite announcements. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/request-access.md. Consumers own authorization.
